API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIUser Authentication SettingsGet Auth Exempted Urls
Get Auth Exempted Urls
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/authSettings/exemptedUrls

Gets a list of URLs that were exempted from cookie authentication. To learn more, see URL Format Guidelines.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
urls
string[]

Domains or URLs which are exempted from SSL Inspection
